criteria_results.evidence: HealthController.java:23 returns ResponseEntity.ok(response) when status is not 'DOWN'.
HealthResponse.java:15-17 defines fields status, timestamp, and components.

criteria_results.description: Database check returns UP when connected
criteria_results.evidence: HealthService.java:26 calls getComponentStatus('db') which uses Actuator's HealthContributorRegistry.

criteria_results.description: Redis check returns UP when connected
criteria_results.evidence: HealthService.java:32 calls getComponentStatus('redis') which uses Actuator's HealthContributorRegistry.

criteria_results.description: Status is 'DOWN' if any component is unavailable
criteria_results.evidence: HealthService.java:28-36 sets overall status to 'DOWN' if either db or redis status is not 'UP'.

suggestions: Consider adding a specific test case for the 'DOWN' status in HealthControllerIT by mocking the HealthContributorRegistry.

commit_message.subject: Add health check endpoint for DB and Redis
commit_message.body:
Implement /api/health endpoint to monitor system availability.
The endpoint returns status, timestamp, and health status for
database and redis components. Integrates with Spring Boot
Actuator Health Indicators to verify dependency connectivity.
